title: Jupiter Wagons Ltd - 533272 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Jupiter Wagons Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 46% YoY to INR671 crore, but EBITDA margin was about 10% and PAT margin 4%.
summary.overview:
Consolidated revenue from operations grew 46% YoY to INR671 crore, with EBITDA up 9% to INR65 crore (about 10% margin) and PAT of INR26 crore (4% margin). Management described Q1 as a transition quarter in which wagon production dipped to about 1,141 units from 1,347 units in Q4 as new private-wagon designs went through prototype approval, and consolidated revenue fell marginally sequentially. Key corporate events were the 100% acquisition of Jupiter Tatravagonka Railwheel Factory, a partnership with Lucchini RS and SIMEST for a combined 25% stake for about INR290 crore, and the RDSO approval of Stone India's freight brake systems with commercial production from July 2026. Jupiter Electric Mobility (JEM) won BESS projects in West Bengal and now has a BESS order book of about 500 MW valued above INR500 crore.</overview>

segments.name: Railway wagons (incl. private)
segments.commentary: Order book about INR3,000 crore; around 80% is private wagon orders per management. Q1 production dipped on prototype approvals for new designs; management expects improvement from Q2 and about 7,000 pending wagons.

segments.name: Wheelsets (JTRWF / Odisha project)
segments.commentary: Order book close to INR700 crore. Odisha facility rated at 100,000 wheelsets; axle line targeted for FY27 and wheel line for FY28, with revenue target INR2,500-3,000 crore and EBITDA of at least 15%.

segments.name: Commercial vehicle bodies / axles
segments.commentary: Order book about INR500 crore. Management cited substantial increase in CV bodies and axles in Q1, while wagons declined.

segments.name: Jupiter Electric Mobility (BESS)
segments.commentary: BESS order book about 500 MW / over INR500 crore after two West Bengal wins (Jeerat, Kharagpur; about INR400 crore, 15-year BOO with WBSEDCL). Target about INR1,000 crore order book in FY27; EBITDA positive from FY28. Project IRR guided at 15%+.

segments.name: Stone India (freight brakes)
segments.commentary: RDSO approval received; commercial production from July 2026. Expected borderline negative EBITDA in Q2, positive from Q3; about 15%+ EBITDA from FY28. Management targets 100% internal supply of freight brakes by end of calendar 2026.

segments.name: JWL DAKO JV
segments.commentary: Expected to start execution in coming quarters; management expects all JVs except JEM to report positive EBITDA before end of Q3 FY27.

guidance_outlook: Management expects 60-70% of current order book to be executed in FY27, with most wagon deliveries scheduled in FY27.
Wagon execution expected to improve over next three quarters versus last year; sharp rise in wagon numbers from Q2 FY27.
JEM targets BESS order book of about INR1,000 crore in FY27 and at least INR5,000 crore over the next three years; EBITDA positive from FY28.
Odisha wheelset project: axle line commissioning in FY27 and wheel line in FY28; majority of capex expected by Q1 FY28; Lucchini RS and SIMEST equity infusion expected before mid-September 2026.
Wheelset project capex unchanged at INR2,600 crore; Jupiter infusion reduced to about INR600 crore from INR900 crore after new partner contributes about INR300 crore.
capex_capacity: Odisha greenfield railway facility: rated capacity about 100,000 wheelsets, 50% for domestic/captive use and 50% for export; partial production targeted by end FY27/Q4-Q1 FY28, full commissioning FY28.
Project capex INR2,600 crore; Jupiter equity infusion now about INR600 crore after new investor contribution.
Jupiter Tatravagonka Railwheel Factory now 100% owned following acquisition of remaining 1.94% stake; Lucchini RS and SIMEST to acquire combined 25% for about INR290 crore.
Stone India freight brake production commenced July 2026; management expects capacity to be reached by end of calendar 2026.
JEM BESS: containerised 10-ft and 20-ft modular BESS formats launched; 110 MW of BESS orders secured for FY27 via MoUs with Chalukya Power and Pickrenew.
demand_pricing: Management says wagon realisation is unchanged; mix shift to non-railway business (higher margin) lifted average realisation to about INR41.5 lakh from INR38 lakh a year ago.

Fresh orders of INR264 crore from JSW Rail Logistics and Central Warehousing Corporation; additional INR211 crore from JSW Port Logistics and Orissa Alloy Steel (7 BOSM rakes, 329 wagons; 150 LSFTO wagons).
Management sees no demand slowdown from Indian Railways; railway loading target of 3.5 lakh million tonnes maintained. Railway wagon tender still awaited, timing not given.

Wheelset market sizing given: India passenger segment 10,000-20,000 units a year (currently imported); general IR about 120,000 new wheelsets plus 150,000-200,000 replacement a year; export offtake from Tatravagonka of 20,000-30,000 wheels a year.
BESS C&I demand reported growing 80-100% month-on-month; management sees no demand challenge.

qa_highlights.question: Segment-wise order book breakup and FY27/FY28 execution profile?
qa_highlights.answer: Railway wagons about INR3,000 crore, wheelsets about INR700 crore, CV bodies about INR500 crore, BESS about INR500 crore; 60-70% of order book to be executed in FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Why did wagon production fall sequentially to 1,141 units from 1,347?
qa_highlights.answer: Transition to new private-wagon designs needed prototype approval, which takes time; execution expected to improve over next three quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Odisha wheelset economics: capacity phases, EBITDA and ramp?
qa_highlights.answer: Axle line in FY27, wheel line in FY28; revenue target INR2,500-3,000 crore and EBITDA at least 15%; 50% captive/domestic and 50% export.

qa_highlights.question: Why are subsidiaries loss-making and when do they turn positive?
qa_highlights.answer: Stone India borderline negative in Q2, positive from Q3; all JVs except JEM expected positive before end-Q3; JEM EBITDA positive only from FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Wheelset project funding after new partner?
qa_highlights.answer: Total capex INR2,600 crore; Jupiter infusion cut to about INR600 crore from INR900 crore as new partner brings about INR300 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Project IRR and funding for West Bengal BESS?
qa_highlights.answer: Project IRR 15%+ due to vertical integration (own containers, BMS, EMS); funding via internal accruals or debt yet to be decided.
